title: HAITI: THE RISE AFTER THE RUIN

sense.text:
Always remember that this took place in the wilderness, on the continent of Africa, not in France or Germany. That alone tells you the people it speaks of are not European.

“Happy art thou, O Israel” is spoken to the twelve tribes of Israel, our people. “O people saved by the Lord”: he saved us out of Egypt. He is “the shield of thy help” at all times, and God is “the sword of thy excellency”: he is our weapon.

“And thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee.” Those enemies are Esau the white man, Ishmael the Arab, Moab the Chinese, all nations, and we are finding out that everything the white man and these nations taught us has been nothing but lies. A book of Bulgarian monasteries, deep in Europe, shows the prophets, the saints, the apostles and Christ on the cross between the two thieves painted as black men; where the faces were whitewashed, some had to be chiselled out and repainted. A 1930 book from Duke University Press, The Lost Tribes a Myth, shows Yemen Jews, Falashas, Berber, Moorish and Negro Jews, maps Levite cities and the sons of Ephraim in Nigeria, and Jewish colonies across Africa. That is how they are found liars. Such books sit in the European, Jewish and Byzantine sections, not the African-American section, put together in hopes that Negroes and Latinos would never get their black hands on them. But there is a God.

So when we say Africa, be mindful: there are Hamites in Africa, who sold us into slavery, and Shemites called Africans, who are our brothers and sisters. Israelites are scattered worldwide. The Levites are not only in Haiti; there is a portion, a remnant, on the island of Haiti.

“And thou shalt tread upon their high places”: we are going to conquer and overthrow them with the power of God when the Lord returns. We are waiting on that part right now.

“That he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is”: the secrets of wisdom are double. The white man never taught that there are double meanings behind these scriptures. Some of those double meanings we can see; some are yet to be revealed.

“Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.” We deserve worse punishment than we have received; he is being lenient with us.

The first three chapters to break down the twelve tribes of Israel are Genesis 49, Deuteronomy 33 and Deuteronomy 28, and you go to Deuteronomy 28 first. If they can't see slavery in Deuteronomy 28, it makes no sense to go to Genesis 49, which is a lot more difficult, or to Deuteronomy 33. Those who ask, what does slavery on ships mean, are scoffers who want to make a mockery; don't waste your time with people like that.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck”. Those are the yokes of iron put on our necks in slavery.

This verse has a dual meaning. “And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass”: the first meaning is that the sky would hold back its rain. The dual meaning is that we did have brass bells over our heads in slavery.

“And the earth that is under thee shall be iron”: the earth would not yield its strength, and we had iron shackles on our legs. That is the duality of the verse.

“And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again”: the word Egypt means captivity, slavery, again, and “with ships”, slave ships, “by the way whereof I spake unto thee”, the way Moses spake unto us. If they can't understand this, brothers, don't waste your time going to Genesis 49 or Deuteronomy 33. They are telling you they are scoffers and choose to be ignorant.

“And there ye shall be sold unto your enemies”: once we got off those ships, we were sold. Among those sold were Indians who were black like us, blacky black. They were classified as Negroes and put off the reservations when reservations came about; only the light-skinned ones who had intermingled were allowed on. So when some say black people were already here, the black people they don't know about are the ones called Indians. The color change came through interracial breeding and rape, though not all light-skinned people come from that; some of us were already light-skinned.

“For bondmen and bondwomen”: slave men and slave women. We went into slavery together, sister, and we are going to be delivered together. The Constitution of the United States itself speaks of us as brought to this country and sold as slaves, and says a free Negro whose ancestors were brought to this country and sold as slaves is not a citizen within its meaning. We are denizens. A citizen does not have to fight for voting rights and civil rights; it would be given to him automatically. We have to fight for everything.

“And no man shall buy you”: the word buy here means redeem. No man shall redeem thee, no man shall save thee. The Black Panther Party tried to save us; Martin Luther King, Marcus Garvey, Fred Hampton, Stokely Carmichael, Sojourner Truth, Harriet Tubman and Fannie Lou Hamer tried; on the continent of Africa Kwame Nkrumah, Thomas Sankara and Patrice Lumumba tried, and Lumumba was assassinated. None of them was able to deliver black people. No man could save us.

precepts.why:
“But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.” Another word for ignorant is stupid. The Bible says let them be stupid, because these are scoffers: I don't know what a slave ship is, I don't know what a shackle of iron around the neck is, we were never in slavery, we were already here. Stop with this foolishness.

So when someone refuses to see the ships of Deuteronomy 28:68, let him be ignorant and move on. Don't waste the scriptures of Genesis 49 and Deuteronomy 33 on him.

“Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge”: you brothers, dwell with your wife according to God's knowledge, “giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel”.

“And as being heirs together of the grace of life”: brothers, we ain't being saved without the woman; sisters, you ain't being saved without the man. “That your prayers be not hindered”: if husbands and wives don't understand that, God ain't hearing their prayers. If you think you get into the kingdom without your spouse, you are sadly mistaken.

That is why the “bondmen and bondwomen” of Deuteronomy 28:68 matters. We went into slavery together and we are going to be delivered together. There are rooms of black women saying black men should die, because the type of man they picked left them with the kids; that is blaming all black men for a bad choice. Regardless of that, God's word will overcome it.

sense.text: Whenever you go to Genesis 49, you have to read verses 1 and 2. The key is the last four words: “that which shall befall you in the last days.” Christian commentaries on Genesis 49 give it no relevance to the last days; they put it in the time of Joshua and leave it there, because they cannot see the duality, the double meaning, of the scriptures. In the last days refers to after the time of Christ: from then until now, what would happen to the twelve tribes.

“Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.” All twelve sons came to their father and he talked to them. But there is another meaning: it is talking about all twelve tribes uniting and coming together.

precepts.why:
“God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets, Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things”.

So from the time of Christ the last days began. From when he was crucified on up to now, we are still in the last days. That is the time Jacob was telling his sons about in Genesis 49:1: what would befall the twelve tribes after Christ, not only what happened in the days of Joshua.

“Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired”. That is called unity, and we have not seen that thing yet.

It speaks the same words as Genesis 49:2 and shows the other meaning of Jacob's call: not only twelve sons coming to their father, but all twelve tribes uniting and coming together in the last days.

sense.text:
“Simeon and Levi are brethren.” What is odd about that? All the twelve tribes are brethren; even Manasseh was adopted in. So why stipulate Simeon and Levi? It lets us know that those two tribes, their children, would be together in the last days. Hence you have Haiti and the Dominican Republic on one island. That is not to say Levi is only there or Simeon is only there; but in this portion of the world, in the last days, they would be together.

“Instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.” The commentaries go to when Simeon and Levi went against the Hamites and fought them. That is true, but it is deeper than that. The instruments of cruelty in their habitations are witchcraft, voodoo. Simeon calls it brujeria; Levi is more famous for it, and they call it voodoo, with movies like The Serpent and the Rainbow made about it.

At the voodoo fest in Haiti, half the women were naked and some of the men too; people were baptized in muddy water summoning spirits, and dogs and goats were sacrificed. One brother married a pretty Haitian sister against counsel, a sister who talked to none of the senior sisters. She would not cook for him, and one day he found a coconut under the bed, salt in one corner, a glass of wine in another, leaves in another: she was trying to put a spell on him. And before the Labor Day parade in New York they hold J'ouvert, putting baby powder on as a spell of protection, men fondling men. That is demonic.

“O my soul, come not thou into their secret”: don't learn their secret, their instruments of cruelty, the brujeria and the voodoo. Don't go into those secret arts, the books of witchcraft. The crystals and so-called healing stones some sisters wear on their necks are witchcraft too, and God says you're going to die for that. “Unto their assembly”: their gatherings.

“Mine honour, be not thou united”: Simeon and Levi would not be united as a people. On the island of Hispaniola, Haiti is on one side and the Dominican Republic on the other, and they are not united in history, economy, environment, language or culture. Haiti was colonized by France, ran as a brutal sugar plantation, won its independence in 1804 through a slave revolt, and was then forced to pay France a crippling indemnity, reparations to the white man. It remains the poorest nation in the Western Hemisphere, its trees cut down for wood and charcoal, speaking Creole and French. The Dominican Republic was colonized by Spain, has a large, stable economy, lush valleys, and speaks Spanish.

They are not united even in feeling: when Levi beat Simeon in a soccer match, Simeon said they could never come back to their stadium, and among Dominicans it is an insult to call someone Haitian. This is how we know that today the Haitians are the tribe of Levi, and Simeon is in the Dominican Republic.

precepts.why:
A precept for their secret. “Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob”: why has God forsaken us? “Because they be replenished from the east”: that is the continent of Africa. “And are soothsayers like the Philistines”: like the Hamites. That is where Levi and Simeon learned it, from the Hamite nations. “And they please themselves in the children of strangers”: the Hamites are the children of strangers they pleased themselves in.

“Their land also is full of silver and gold” and “their land is also full of horses”: that is the continent. “Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made”. Just like on the continent of Africa, they do it in Haiti and in the Dominican Republic. “And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself” to the idols.

“Therefore forgive them not.” God said he is not going to forgive them. This is why we see so much turmoil over there, especially in Haiti.

sense.text: “When thou art come into the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.” Those nations are the Hamites. When we went into the land under Joshua there were Canaanites, Philistines and Amorites, and God warned us not to follow or do what they do. This is the witchcraft of Simeon and Levi in Genesis 49.

“There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire”: don't sacrifice your children to other gods, don't get them killed. America calls that abortion today; it is the same thing. During J'ouvert and Simeon's carnival, married people are allowed to have sex with other people, and the married women get pregnant by another man. Today those children are called carnival babies. Back then those were the children they sacrificed to Molech and the other gods, not the children of their natural husbands.

“Or that useth divination”: divination is witchcraft. “Or an observer of times”: your horoscopes, the zodiac, what's your sign; if you're a Taurus, Wednesday's not your day, so stay home. “Or an enchanter, or a witch.”

“Or a charmer”: lucky charms, the rabbit's foot. A cross on your neck, thinking you get blessed from it, is a charm. The six-pointed star is a charm: some thought God protected them for wearing it, and Israelite kids today still wear it though they know it is not in the Bible. An elder once said, show me the Shield of David in the Bible and I'll wear it; and searching every concordance, it cannot be found. In the Jewish book section there is a book of Jewish mysticism called Kabbalah, and there that six-pointed star is a symbol of protection from witchcraft and sorcery. It has nothing to do with King David; it was originally called the Seal of Solomon.

“Or a consulter with familiar spirits”: spirits familiar to you, like in the movie Ghost, bring up my aunt, bring up my uncle, spirits of those who died. God says don't deal with that stuff, and that is what they do on the island of Hispaniola, modern-day Haiti. “Or a wizard”: a wizard is a male witch. “Or a necromancer”: someone who deals with the dead. They touch the dead, feel the dead, sex the dead, conjure the dead.

“For all that do these things are an abomination unto the Lord: and because of these abominations the Lord thy God doth drive them out from before thee.” God kicked out the other nations that were in the land doing these things, so he is warning us: don't you follow behind them. “Thou shalt be perfect with the Lord thy God.”

precepts.why:
“Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan”. The six-pointed star, the Seal of Solomon, is the star of Remphan.

When Solomon grew old, his wives and concubines, who worshipped other gods, had him serve their gods; he gave himself to folly. That is when the Seal of Solomon came about, with the worship of these gods under Remphan.

So the star worn on the neck is no shield of David. It is the star of a false god, a charm, the very thing Deuteronomy 18:11 forbids.

“But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.” The star of your god, which you made to yourselves.

This sign has been around forever, and it has always been identified with witchcraft and evil. So we are not to wear it. If you have it on your neck right now as a charm, take it off. It means no good to you.

sense.text: “And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.” Before Moses died he prayed for all twelve tribes of Israel, and he gave us instructions on what would happen to us in the last days.

“The Lord came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints”. This has a dual meaning too. It happened in that time, when Moses went up and dealt with the Lord in the fiery bush and gave us the law, “a fiery law”. And it is going to happen again.

“Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet”. These saints are not the angels; the angels were not sitting down at the Lord's feet. This is talking about us, our people, the twelve tribes. “Every one shall receive of thy words.”

“Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob. And he was king in Jeshurun”. That is important. Moses was never given the title of a king, like King Saul, our first official king, then King David and King Solomon. But it says he was king in Jeshurun: Moses was as a king to us, “when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.”

“And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one”. The Thummim and the Urim were how the Most High spoke to the high priest: the stones on the shoulders, with the ephod in the center. Before Christ the high priest was always a Levite, and the Holy Spirit came down and instructed us through them. So Moses is telling Levi: talk to the Most High, talk to God, not the devil. Because, as we read in Genesis 49, Levi would leave off talking to the Most High God and deal with satanic spirits.

“Whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah” is the history. When Moses was gone forty days and forty nights, we went into idolatry, arguing, fighting, having orgies, evil as hell, and Moses told the men, especially Levi, whoever is on the Lord's side, come on this side.

“Neither did he acknowledge his brethren”: if you broke the law, Levi killed you. That was God's instruction to them; Levi was devout and strict. “Nor knew his own children”: if his own children did something, the Levite said, put that child to death. They didn't say, oh, that's my son, that's my daughter, let's make an excuse. They had to die. That was Levi's mentality, “for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.”
“They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law”: it was the Levites' job to teach us the judgments and the law. “They shall put incense before thee”.

“Bless, Lord, his substance, and accept the work of his hands”: Moses is praying that God bless Levi's substance and accept the work of Levi's hands.

“Smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him” goes into the history of what Levi would do in the future. They did it in the time of the Maccabees: it was Levi that led us against the Greeks. And Levi fought against this bastard, Napoleon Bonaparte, in Haiti, in a war of thirteen years, from 1791 to 1804. Napoleon was called one of the greatest generals who ever lived, yet a self-educated captive with no military training, Toussaint Louverture, drove him out of Haiti and led his country to independence. The uprising began with a coordinated revolt in August 1791; Jean-Jacques Dessalines defeated the French at the Battle of Vertières on November 18, 1803; independence was declared on January 1, 1804. It was not one man but many leaders: Dutty Boukman, Henri Christophe, Alexandre Pétion and others, and François Makandal before them, whose resistance from the mountains led up to the revolution. Dessalines said, we have repaid these true cannibals, war for war, crime for crime, outrage for outrage.

The white man makes a movie of Napoleon's victories over other countries and leaves out his whooping at the hands of the Haitians. That is propaganda. Word of what happened spread throughout the Americas, and that is why they said, we got to do something with these Negroes. Then Haiti crossed to the Dominican side, freed them from slavery, and united the whole island; when the white elite re-annexed it to Spain, Haiti supplied the black Dominican rebels with arms, fighters and safe harbor until the Spanish were defeated. Those who wanted to be back under Spain were the mixed children with allegiance to their white parent. That history has been taken out, which is why so many Dominicans hate the Haitians today. Henri Christophe's citadel on the mountain and his palace, ahead of their time, look like what Judah and Benjamin built in Spain, Portugal and England: the spirit was with us, even as they spread the propaganda that Haitians are ignorant and can do nothing.

“That they rise not again.” Now you may say, they have risen again. Yes, they have. That last part is for when our King returns: he is going to give us that power, that they never rise again.

precepts.why:
“If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say; If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, when men rose up against us: Then they had swallowed us up quick”. If it wasn't for the Lord, the nations that rose up against us, the French, the English, the Spanish, would have swallowed us up quick, “when their wrath was kindled against us”. “Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul”: the waters are the nations.

“Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth”: blessed be the Lord, who has not allowed us to be destroyed as a race, as a people. “Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped. Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.”

That is what Deuteronomy 33:11 is talking about: “smite through the loins of them that rise against him”. We defeated the Greeks, and the Spanish and the French, because the Lord was on our side.

sense.text: “And now, O ye priests, this commandment is for you.” The priests were the Levites, so here the prophet Malachi is speaking directly to the tribe of Levi.

“I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already”. When you read chapter 1, Levi had started to sacrifice blind and broken sheep and goats with three legs; everything was jacked up. They were sacrificing things to the Lord the Lord did not want.

“Behold, I will corrupt your seed”: I will corrupt your children. “And spread dung upon your faces, even the dung of your solemn feasts”. People read that and say it's metaphoric. No, it is literal as well. Mainstream Haitian voodoo says feces are not a feature of standard practice, but they are used in three places: magical defenses and contagious magic, the black magic of secret societies like the Bizango, and around the bayakou, the laborers who empty the pit latrines by hand at night. Hair, fingernails, clothing and bodily waste are believed to carry a person's essence, so a sorcerer who gets them can anchor a curse; in aggressive spells a target's feces is mixed with hot peppers or graveyard dirt to rot them from the inside out. Talismanic bundles, charms and ritual tokens are found hidden in the latrines. Didn't we read in Deuteronomy not to deal with that stuff? It's all there.

“And one shall take you away with it”: one shall deceive you and convince you to go that way.

“That my covenant might be with Levi”. “My covenant was with him of life and peace”: the Lord's covenant was with the Levites. “For the fear wherewith he feared me, and was afraid before my name”: Levi at one time respected the one true God, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. “The law of truth was in his mouth”: Levi respected the law at one time. “And iniquity was not found in his lips”: they told no lies. “He walked with me in peace and equity, and did turn many away from iniquity”. That starts with Moses.

“For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth”. Brothers who call themselves priests, your lips should keep knowledge, and the people should seek the law at the priest's mouth, “for he is the messenger of the Lord of hosts.”
“But ye are departed out of the way; ye have caused many to stumble at the law”. Today, you Haitians have caused many to stumble at God's law. “Ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi”.

“Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people”: hated. That is why Judah used to chase the Haitians down the street and whip them for their clothes, high waters and polka-dot socks; then they would go home and try to put a voodoo spell on us, and that don't work. Among Dominicans it is a big insult to be called Haitian. This ain't man saying this; it is what the Bible said, prophecy, what God would do to the tribe of Levi, “according as ye have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.”

precepts.why:
For anyone getting nervous now, saying the stuff might work on me, my neighbor put a voodoo curse on me, she took my drawers and buried them in the yard: “Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel”. Brothers and sisters, if you are in this truth, witchcraft don't work on you. No divination can work against Israel. Balaam the witch was telling Balak, witchcraft don't work on these people.

But if you have not repented, if you're just sitting around, it will work on you. Your stomach hurting and bloating, one leg shrinking up and you don't know why: somebody put a voodoo hex on your black behind. You better repent. That is the protection against the dung and the spells of Malachi 2:3.

sense.text:
“And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon”. Tyre and Sidon were Hamite nations, modern-day Lebanon. “But they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king’s chamberlain their friend”: they befriended, flattered and gave gifts to Herod's chamberlain, and “desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king’s country.” Herod's country fed Tyre and Sidon, so they had to obey. They didn't want Herod to be mad at them, because if they let his anger go on, he could cut them off from their food supply.

This has been happening from the time of Rome, and it is what is being done to Haiti. Haiti imports roughly 50 to 85 percent of its total food supply, about 80 percent of its rice, and is fully dependent on imports for wheat and vegetable oils, mainly from the United States, then the Dominican Republic, Canada, Malaysia and China. If Haiti does not obey Esau, they'll cut off the food supply. Esau did this on purpose: Haiti at one time grew its own rice, and Bill Clinton destroyed it and made Haiti accept food from the United States. It is the same with Jamaica: when Trump said kick out the Cuban doctors, they did it, because they are under America. America, Babylon the Great, is the great puppet master.

precepts.why:
“The life of him that dependeth on another man’s table is not to be counted for a life”. Brother, if your life depends on another man's table, that's not a life, because your food is dependent on another man. “For he polluteth himself with other men’s meat”: you are polluting yourself with other men's meat. That is why the Bible tells us to be self-sufficient and always maintain the preeminence: “but a wise man well nurtured will beware thereof.”

“Begging is sweet in the mouth of the shameless: but in his belly there shall burn”. You're begging.

That is Haiti and its 50 to 80 percent: like Tyre and Sidon nourished by Herod's country, a nation fed from another man's table is not living a life. Esau has it set up so that everyone is dependent on him.

sense.text:
This is written by King Solomon: “I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun”, all the oppressions done under the sun to his people. “And behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter”: our people have no comforter. “And on the side of their oppressors there was power”: on the side of the white man there was power, economic power, political power, military power. “But they had no comforter.”

That is what is done to Haiti. When President Jean-Bertrand Aristide, in a speech on April 7, 2003, suddenly called on France for reparations, billions of dollars, the French called it explosive, and diplomats now concede it was part of his undoing. America kidnapped him and his wife in the night with a bag over their heads and flew him off to Africa, then said, we don't kidnap people; look at Venezuela and Maduro. That's what they do. When they let him come back, they warned him: open your black lips again and you're going to die. When God says America is Babylon the Great, God knows what he's talking about.

Haiti is run from the shadows by six families, the BAM BAM, an acronym that sounds like gimme gimme in Creole: Brandt, Acra, Madsen, Bigio, Apaid and Mevs. They came in the late 1800s and early 1900s as refugees from Syria, Palestine, Lebanon, and later European Jews, and a lot of them are Amalek, though they don't say it. They control 80 to 90 percent of Haiti's wealth, the private ports, the imports, and the gangs, avoid taxes, and destroy any black entrepreneur who challenges them, while some 66 percent of Haitians survive on next to nothing. Everyone given a flyer in Haiti asked for money. It is not just Barbecue and the gangs; until those six families are removed, the problem stays in Haiti. That is what the police commissioner was told, and he stayed quiet.

Our people in Christianity have a deaf ear to this. They say, I'm not oppressed, because they see the benefits America gives, quote unquote. A few elite blacks say we're not oppressed; but the bulk and masses of our people are oppressed.

precepts.why:
What we just read in Ecclesiastes is the truth of what is going on in society today. “The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours”: the natural resources. “Shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway”.

This goes with Haiti: the land holds gold, copper, bauxite and iridium, with limestone and marble, precious metal reserves estimated at nearly twenty billion dollars, and yet the people are only oppressed and crushed. A nation they knew not eats up the fruit of their land, and on the side of the oppressors there is power.

sense.text:
“Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together”. Always remember that.

Esau knew who he had in slavery. The 1930 book The Lost Tribes, a Myth speaks of Levite cities in Nigeria, of a far-travelled African Judaism among the Hausa that did not come from European Judaism, of a powerful Levitical institution there, and of Caesar, Kaiser, remembered as the ancient oppressor of Israel. It speaks of the Jews of Angola and of Negro Jews in Jamaica and Surinam, and it records a man saying every black man is a real Hebrew, whether he knows it or not. The Levites are not only in Haiti. Amalek still keeps close tabs on our brothers in Nigeria who know they are Israelites, to make sure they don't teach what we teach.

A Haitian, Jean Baptiste Point du Sable, founded Chicago. Before the Mayflower shows that the first slaves spoke Spanish and had Spanish names, because they came out of Spain: those were the Moors, the Moorish Jews that ruled Spain and Portugal. And blacks from Haiti came to fight for America in the front ranks at the siege of Savannah. So those who call themselves foundational black Americans and dismiss the Haitians, the Jamaicans and the other tribes of Israel are carrying stupidity that comes from Esau.

precepts.why:
“Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord?” He says it because the Lord has not been intervening the way we want him to. “Arise, cast us not off for ever. Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression? For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth. Arise for our help”, “and redeem us”.

That is the cry of Israel and Judah oppressed together, calling on the Lord to arise for our help.

“Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication. Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise”. That is what we are supposed to be doing, mourning and complaining and making noise, “because of the voice of the enemy”, his propaganda, “because of the oppression of the wicked”, the things he has set up to oppress us systematically.

“For they cast iniquity upon me”: they say we are the worst in society. “And in wrath they hate me”: in wrath they hate our race, they hate our people. This is what God says, and y'all keep thinking they love you. Those who say I don't see color find out too late.

“Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.” That is where we pray to the Lord: deliver me from the oppression of man. “Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes. Rivers of waters run down mine eyes”: tears, crying, “because they keep not thy law.”

sense.text:
This is what the Most High told all of us. We can't get caught up in this foolishness of Judah against Levi, Levi against Benjamin, Simeon against Levi. Some who call themselves foundational black Americans dismiss the other tribes: if you're Haitian you're not accepted, if you're Jamaican you're not accepted; they don't deal with Haitians, Jamaicans, Brazilians, Panamanians, Hondurans, Mexicans or Puerto Ricans. And among our people you have a Haitian woman calling black Americans dirty. Where is this coming from? Esau. It's the white man's talking point, and those who carry it get it from the white man.

“Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired”. Nobody desires black Americans. Nobody desires Haitians, Jamaicans, Trinidadians, Mexicans. Nobody. God is saying gather yourselves together, and we are busy fighting with each other. Stop the foolishness; it must be ended.

The Haitians are the ones being given ankle monitors in Ohio after their Temporary Protected Status ended, while Ukraine's protection is extended and white South Africans are welcomed as refugees. A twenty-year-old Haitian college student in Springfield, Ohio, never arrested, took his own life days after being made to wear one. When the white man puts us to death, he doesn't ask, are you FBA, are you Haitian, are you Jamaican; he looks at us all the same, by the same skin color. After the Haitians, who do you think is next?

Esau sticks together; our people, the children of Jacob, don't stick together. We must learn to come together as one. “Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart”: that goes for all the twelve tribes, whatever stupid thing is said, like the Haitian sister saying you're a dirty black American. So what? Teach your children, brothers and sisters. We cannot get pulled into the foolishness, the evil hate speech. God set us up for a bigger plan, the gathering of the twelve tribes of Israel, so that we can rule this planet.

“Thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour”: correct them, “and not suffer sin upon him”: teach him the law.

“Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge”. Don't bear no grudge; I don't care if they call us dirty black, so what? We're the Israelites the Bible speaks of; let's keep it moving. “Against the children of thy people”: that is racial love, love of the children of your race.

precepts.why:
“Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.” Unity is the word we have never understood and never seen a prime example of. But here we must show an example of unity among our people.

“There is one body”: the twelve tribes are the one body, “and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling; One Lord, one faith, one baptism”, and that baptism is the teachings, “One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all”: in you Israelites.

Unity: we must teach and exemplify unity. That is what it means not to hate thy brother in thine heart.

sense.text: They say the church took the place of the twelve tribes. Here's the answer to that: “Hath God cast away his people? God forbid.” That means no. “For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.” So God has not cast away his people.

“And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.” That further proves God has not done away with the twelve tribes of Israel.

These are the leaders. How are they going to be sealed if nobody knows who they are? They say, you Israelites, you don't know who the twelve tribes are. Then how are we supposed to get them sealed if we don't know who or where they are? See the foolishness in that.

“Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand.” So Levi is still here today. “Of the tribe of Joseph”: that Joseph is Ephraim.

Those twelve thousand of each tribe are the leaders who are going to rule the planet, and under them are the rest of the Israelites.
“After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues”. Of all nations: that is the Israelites.

precepts.why: For the new brothers and new sisters: what is the seal? “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” The seal is the law. The hundred and forty and four thousand of the tribes of Israel are sealed with the law among the disciples.

“And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name”. “And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee”.

A nation and a company of nations shall come of Israel, “and kings shall come out of thy loins”. That is the “all nations” of Revelation 7:9: the great multitude of all nations is the company of nations that came out of Jacob. Stop being a fool by these churches.

sense.text: “And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi”. God said he is going to purify the sons of Levi, “and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the Lord an offering in righteousness.”

“Therefore will he give them up”: God gave us up into slavery, “until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth”: we have to bring forth repentance. “Then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.” Why do we have to return? Because we forgot our way. We got lost thinking we are Jamaicans, Haitians, African-Americans, Mexicans, Puerto Ricans, Hondurans.
“And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the Lord, in the majesty of the name of the Lord his God”: that is what he is going to do.

“And this man shall be the peace”: Christ is our peace. “When the Assyrian shall come into our land”: that is Amalek coming into our land; Amalek took the land over. “And when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.” Seven shepherds and eight principal men: that is fifteen.

“And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword”: the sword is the word of God. “And the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof”: that is America, Babylon. Remember, Nimrod was over Babylon. “Thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian”: that is Amalek, “when he cometh into our land”. Amalek is in the land now; he is taking over the entire US government. “And when he treadeth within our borders”: that is what is going to happen in the future.
“As the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men”. We ain't waiting for no man. God is our King.

“And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep”: we are going to be in the midst of these nations as a lion, like a young lion. What can sheep do to a lion? Nothing but be food. “Who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces”: we shall tread them down and tear the nations in pieces. “And none can deliver”: nobody is going to deliver the nations out of our hands.

“Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.” Our hands shall be lifted up upon our adversaries, and all our enemies shall be cut off. Twelve tribes, twelve tribes, twelve tribes.

precepts.why:
Who are the seven shepherds and the eight principal men? “See the people that cometh from the east: Unto whom I will give for leaders, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, Oseas, Amos, and Micheas, Joel, Abdias, and Jonas, Nahum, and Abacuc, Sophonias, Aggeus, Zachary, and Malachy, which is called also an angel of the Lord.”

Count those names: fifteen. Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, then Hosea, Amos, Micah, Joel, Obadiah, Jonah, Nahum, Habakkuk, Zephaniah, Haggai, Zechariah and Malachi. That is what we were reading in Micah: the seven shepherds and eight principal men raised against the Assyrian are these fifteen leaders.
